note: Every union the platform names: the unions in the programmes' `union` strings (WebXR/smartcity/js/curricula.js) and the registry's `body: "union"` entries (tools/standards.json), plus IBB, which one station's certification names. No union logo is reproduced anywhere in this repository: WebXR/shared/signage.js typesets a wordmark from `abbrev` and `name`. `local` is set only where the repository already names exactly one local for that union with certainty; a union the repository names several locals of gets null. `colors` is null throughout, because no union's colour scheme has been confirmed public and certain; null means the platform palette. `trainingBody` is the registry id of the union's training fund or programme, or null where the registry has none. `aliases` are the spellings the platform's own text uses, so a programme's `union` string can be resolved to these ids (see unionsNamed() in signage.js). Bodies that are not unions (the Red Cross, NATE, the ADHA, ADAA and DANB, the PMA, AWS, RETA) are not listed. tools/gen_unions.mjs writes WebXR/shared/unions.js from this file; tools/check_signage.mjs gates both.

unions.name: American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees
unions.note: Public-service, public-health and air-district members.

unions.name: Amalgamated Transit Union
unions.note: Bus and rail transit operations.

unions.name: International Union of Bricklayers and Allied Craftworkers
unions.note: Training through the International Masonry Institute.

unions.name: Bakery, Confectionery, Tobacco Workers and Grain Millers International Union
unions.note: Bakery and grain-handling work.

unions.name: Brotherhood of Maintenance of Way Employes Division
unions.note: Track and structures maintenance; a division of the Teamsters.

unions.name: United Brotherhood of Carpenters and Joiners of America
unions.note: Carpenters, pile drivers and millwrights. The repository names Pile Drivers Local 34 for the marine work only, so no local is carried on the union's general sign.

unions.name: Communications Workers of America
unions.note: Outside-plant, tower and broadcast work.

unions.name: International Association of Fire Fighters
unions.note: Fire and EMS.

unions.name: International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers
unions.note: Machinist and transportation training at the Winpisinger Center.

unions.name: International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees
unions.note: Stagecraft, rigging and entertainment electrical work.

unions.name: International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers
unions.note: Inside and outside wireman apprenticeship with NECA. The programmes name IBEW locals in the plural, so no single local is carried.

unions.name: International Longshore and Warehouse Union
unions.note: Longshore, crane and clerk work, trained jointly with the PMA.

unions.name: Inlandboatmen's Union of the Pacific
unions.note: The ILWU's marine division: ferry, tug and barge crews.

unions.name: International Association of Bridge, Structural, Ornamental and Reinforcing Iron Workers
unions.note: Structural, ornamental and reinforcing ironwork, trained with IMPACT.

unions.name: International Union of Operating Engineers
unions.note: Operating and stationary engineers. The repository names both Local 3 (operating) and Local 39 (stationary), so no single local is carried.

unions.name: International Union of Painters and Allied Trades
unions.note: Industrial painters, glaziers and drywall finishers, trained through the Finishing Trades Institute.

unions.name: Laborers' International Union of North America
unions.note: Construction craft laborers and hazardous-waste crews. Local 261 is the one LIUNA local the repository names (the Hunters Point programme).

unions.name: Marine Engineers' Beneficial Association
unions.note: Licensed marine engineers, trained at the Calhoon MEBA Engineering School.

unions.name: National Association of Emergency Medical Technicians
unions.note: A professional association rather than a union; listed because the registry files its course programmes under the union body.

unions.name: National Association of Social Workers
unions.note: A professional association rather than a union; listed because the registry files its Code of Ethics under the union body.

unions.name: Service Employees International Union
unions.note: Clinic, food-service, janitorial and public-service members. The repository names SEIU 87, SEIU-USWW and SEIU 1021, so no single local is carried.

unions.name: Workers United
unions.note: Garment and textile workers; an SEIU affiliate, trained through the SEIU and Workers United education funds.

unions.name: Seafarers International Union
unions.note: Unlicensed mariners, trained at the Paul Hall Center.

unions.name: International Association of Sheet Metal, Air, Rail and Transportation Workers
unions.note: Sheet metal and rail transportation, trained through the International Training Institute.

unions.name: International Brotherhood of Teamsters
unions.note: Warehouse, driving and regulated-soil haul.

unions.name: Transport Workers Union of America
unions.note: Transit and airline ground operations.

unions.name: United Association of Journeymen and Apprentices of the Plumbing and Pipe Fitting Industry of the United States and Canada
unions.note: Plumbers, pipefitters and HVAC service. Local 38 is the one UA local the repository names (the Hunters Point programme).

unions.name: International Union, United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America
unions.note: Manufacturing and automation skilled trades.

unions.name: United Food and Commercial Workers International Union
unions.note: Retail food, clinic and dental support work.

unions.name: UNITE HERE
unions.note: Hotel, food-service and hospitality workers. Local 2 is the one UNITE HERE local the repository names (the culinary, bar and hotel programmes).

unions.name: United Steelworkers
unions.note: Plant crews; health, safety and environmental training at the Tony Mazzocchi Center.

unions.name: National Nurses United
unions.note: Named in the outbreak-response programme; the registry carries no NNU training entry.

unions.name: California Nurses Association
unions.note: Named in the outbreak-response programme; an NNU affiliate. The registry carries no CNA training entry.

unions.name: National Association of Government Employees
unions.note: Named in the first-responders programme for EMS locals; an SEIU affiliate. The registry carries no NAGE training entry.

unions.name: Fraternal Order of Police
unions.note: Named in the first-responders programme; the registry carries no FOP training entry.

unions.name: International Brotherhood of Boilermakers, Iron Ship Builders, Blacksmiths, Forgers and Helpers
unions.note: Named by the shipyard hot-work station's certification; the registry carries no IBB training entry.
